Baseline for the realistic capacity soak fixture (issue #195), captured
before any optimization ticket touches these read paths. Reproduce with:

  go test ./internal/server -run '^$' \
    -bench 'BenchmarkCapacityRealistic' -benchtime=5x -benchmem

Compare a later run against this file with benchstat:

  go test ./internal/server -run '^$' \
    -bench 'BenchmarkCapacityRealistic' -benchtime=5x -benchmem \
    | tee internal/server/testdata/capacity_realistic_after.txt
  benchstat internal/server/testdata/capacity_realistic_baseline.txt \
    internal/server/testdata/capacity_realistic_after.txt

Machine: local development workstation (not a certification runner);
this baseline is for regression comparison, not a certified objective.
Fixture: 200 published Sessions across 20 Lanes / 20 Locations / 8
Tracks, mixed lifecycles (Ended/Live/Canceled/Scheduled), one captured
Public Schedule Baseline, 30 Displays.

goos: linux
goarch: amd64
pkg: github.com/dotwaffle/beamers/internal/server
cpu: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor
